summary.text: Telisa Franklin is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She also sought the Democratic nomination for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Telisa Franklin ran in the August 1, 2024 Democratic primary for Tennessee House District 96, finishing second with 41.3% of the vote behind Gabby Salinas, who received 43.9%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for the seat on August 6, 2026.
